props.bug: the cap is checked against the supply BEFORE minting (`>=`), not against the supply AFTER minting (`new_supply > CAP`), so the last mint can overshoot the cap.
props.title: Capped mint
props.blurb: A token must never exceed its supply cap of 1000. The cap is checked against the supply before minting, so the last mint can overshoot.

props.bug: sorting 4 elements needs 3 passes, this one stops after 2.
props.title: Buggy sort
props.blurb: Sorts four numbers with bubble sort, but stops one pass too early: four numbers need three passes and it makes two.

props.title: Pair sum
props.blurb: A deliberately false claim: the sum of two numbers is always below 10.

props.title: Saturating add
props.blurb: A property that holds: saturating addition never goes below its left operand.

props.bug: after an account is drained to exactly 0, its next deposit is credited twice (the books still count it once).
props.title: Bank sequence
props.blurb: A tiny bank with three accounts. After an account is drained to zero, its next deposit is credited twice, so the books stop adding up. One command can never show it: it takes a whole sequence.
props.property: after every command: deposited == balances + withdrawn

props.bug: x * 1000 is computed in u64 and overflows (the code panics) for x >= 18446744073709552. A panic cannot be returned as false, so this property needs panic recovery.
props.title: Overflow panic
props.blurb: The code multiplies by 1000 in 64-bit arithmetic and overflows for large inputs: the property panics instead of returning false. The page catches the panic, finds the first panicking case by bisecting the case limit, and shrinks by replaying candidates.
props.property: x * 1000 / 1000 == x (a panic counts as a failure)
